title: Inter-Patient Congestive Heart Failure Detection Using ECG-Convolution-Vision Transformer Network.
summary: ECVT-Net distinguished CHF from normal ECG beats under a patient-separated evaluation, reporting 98.88% accuracy. The result is limited to the two named databases and does not establish clinical deployment or disease-specific generalization across acquisition sources.
ai_technology: A convolutional/vision-transformer network operates on ECG heartbeat segments; Methods §§2–3 describe MIT-BIH normal and BIDMC CHF databases and patient-grouped splits.
organization: School of Electronic and Information Engineering (SEIE); College of Communication Engineering

evidence.tested: Inter-patient Results §3 reports 98.88% accuracy (98.94% average sensitivity; CHF sensitivity 99.79%) on held-out patients.
evidence.unknown: Patient-separated test scheme is reported, but normal and CHF classes come from different databases, so database/acquisition differences may confound apparent disease discrimination.
evidence.ai_role: A convolutional/vision-transformer network operates on ECG heartbeat segments; Methods §§2–3 describe MIT-BIH normal and BIDMC CHF databases and patient-grouped splits.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
